articles.title: Ravens fined $100K for Jackson injury 'mistake'
articles.summary: The NFL fined the Baltimore Ravens $100,000 on Friday for violating the league's injury report policy by incorrectly listing quarterback Lamar Jackson's practice participation last week.

articles.title: QB Purdy closer, but 49ers starting Jones vs. NYG
articles.summary: Quarterback Mac Jones will make his fifth straight start Sunday against the Giants while starter Brock Purdy, who could be available, continues to recover from a toe injury, coach Kyle Shanahan announced Friday.

articles.title: Grier out as Fins GM; McDaniel to finish season
articles.summary: Chris Grier is out as Miami Dolphins general manager, the team announced Friday, but head coach Mike McDaniel will keep his position through at least the regular season, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

articles.title: Bowles reveals broken neck bone for WR McMillan
articles.summary: Tampa Bay Buccaneers coach Todd Bowles said wide receiver Jalen McMillan suffered a broken bone in his neck after an awkward fall backward during a preseason game at Pittsburgh in August.

articles.title: Jags putting Hunter on IR; ACL intact, per source
articles.summary: Jaguars wide receiver/cornerback Travis Hunter will be placed on injured reserve, with a source saying the rookie's ACL is intact and that no answers about his long-term outlook are expected before next week.

articles.title: Steelers' DB woes worsen as Peppers, Clark out
articles.summary: Steelers safeties Jabrill Peppers (quad) and Chuck Clark (illness) have been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Colts.

articles.title: Witherspoon back for Seattle; safety Love out
articles.summary: The Seahawks will get Pro Bowl cornerback Devon Witherspoon back for their Sunday night game against Washington, but they'll again be without starting safety Julian Love.
